title: This sub is weird….
content: I have never heard of this sub before or about the idea. However, I have a “memory” or something similar of going into a vr booth or cabinet thing in a big mall. I’m not sure where this thought or memory came from but I distinctly remember it. I remember being with a group of friends or my family… I vaguely remember talking about this VR experience and joking about it but being nervous.
